title: Act 2 - Chapter 6: Route 42, Mt. Mortar & Mahogany Town (Pryce & Glacier Badge)
synopsis: Cross the rugged northern mountain pass of Route 42 and explore the subterranean depths of Mt. Mortar to claim ancient hold items and a gifted Tyrogue. Travel north through Route 43 to the rain-swept Lake of Rage to confront the static Shiny Red Gyarados alongside Dragon Master Lance. Finally, solve the ice rink hockey puzzle in Mahogany Gym to challenge Gym Leader Pryce in a 5 vs 5 duel for the Glacier Badge.
